qa_scope: Independent read-only review of mirror candidate against current approved right-running row. The user has accepted the known mirrored-hand/held-fish screen-side tradeoff. No source or formal atlas was modified in this task.

acceptance.geometry: pass — invariants report every left frame is an exact horizontal mirror of the current right frame; contact sheet shows matching whole-body silhouette, frame scale, baseline and crop.
acceptance.frame_order: pass — frame order preserved F0-F7; mirrored contact sheet retains the right row sequence rather than reversing frame order.
acceptance.timing: pass — preview has 8 frames with 120 ms for F0-F6 and 220 ms for F7, total 1060 ms, matching approved right timing.
acceptance.phase_and_cadence: pass by exact derivation — lower-body support/swing phase, 0/4 half-cycle relation and 7→0 seam are exactly those of approved right row under horizontal reflection. This does not claim independent anatomical superiority of the source right row; it confirms no new left-row phase defect or cadence drift was introduced.
acceptance.limb_count: pass by exact derivation and visual contact-sheet inspection — no third hand, extra leg, duplicated shoe or detached limb is introduced by the mirror operation. Existing approved-right silhouette is reflected as a whole.
acceptance.direction: pass — reflected character travels/faces screen-left in image coordinates. Foot and body motion are the horizontal reflection of screen-right reference; no frame-level reversal artifact observed.
acceptance.identity_and_scale: pass — face, hat, hair, plush material, palette, body scale, fish prop and relative anchor geometry remain identical under reflection.
acceptance.color_and_transparency: pass for review candidate — no visible color drift between mirror and current right reference in contact sheet; preview retains transparent background metadata. Final atlas/v2 validation must still be rerun after assembly.
acceptance.preview_loop: pass for source preview — GIF decodes as 8 frames and loops; static contact and preview show no introduced jump or size pop attributable to mirroring.

accepted_tradeoff.detail: Horizontal reflection moves the held fish and holding hand to the opposite screen side in the left run. This is intentional and accepted for this release option; it is not counted as an unknown defect.
accepted_tradeoff.not_verified: Whether the user later prefers side-consistent holding-hand semantics remains a product choice outside this QA; this QA does not override the explicit acceptance.

limitations_and_next_checks: This is a deterministic mirror option, not a newly generated independent left anatomy solution. Its phase quality is inherited from the approved right row.
Contact sheet and GIF QA do not replace final 192x208 extraction, transparent WebP/PNG decoding checks, v2 atlas validation, and assembled-row playback in the final atlas.
No claim is made about the native Codex overlay cache until parent workflow installs/refreshes and observes it.
decision: The mirror option is eligible for assembly as the accepted left-run candidate, subject to parent workflow final extraction, atlas validation, and final playback checks. Do not treat this report as installation or publication approval by itself.

source_invariants_recorded.tradeoff: Held fish and holding hand appear on opposite screen side in left run; all costume, face, geometry, motion and colors mirror together.
